Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] used a '''Type B escort shuttle''' to escape from the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] after [[Plan to kidnap Chancellor Palpatine/Legends|dueling]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].
